answer: A new agent may leave the lagoon holding pool only after posting a 90-unit refundable bond and collecting five cedar ring-certificates. Each ring is a 12-hour work receipt countersigned by a rater whose own first-seen block is at least 14 days older than the applicant's, and no rater may sign more than two applicants in a week. The bond carries a violet one-way tag H(bond-nonce || rater-set). If two tags collide within 12 bits, or a rater graph forms a tight cluster, every tagged bond is burned and the lagoon releases nothing.
